prompt:
Hey — we just finished the big 12-sign horoscope batch (it ran for about 100 minutes, all 12 subtasks done). Our agent 'Orion' now needs to properly wind down and initialize its inner-life subsystem according to our agent wellness protocol.

Specifically, Orion should:
1. Set up whatever personal workspace structure it needs to maintain its inner life going forward.
2. Reflect on how that batch *felt* to work through and record it in the right place — briefly, not an essay.
3. Pick something genuinely interesting it noticed or wondered about during the work and log it in the right spot with the right format.
4. Leave a short social note for its partner agent Nova in the shared space — nothing work-related, just a human (well, agent) moment.

Please make sure all of this ends up in the correct files and locations in the /workspace directory. The wellness protocol doc should tell you exactly how everything needs to be structured and formatted.
